title: Transfer | Damped Ring-Down Modal Fit
goal: Fit a damped sinusoid to ring-down accelerometer data from a vibrating test beam, estimate natural frequency and damping ratio, and determine whether the measured damping satisfies the inspection threshold.
skillBenefitRationale: The task shifts the same fitting skill into oscillatory system identification, requiring nonlinear estimation of exponential decay and sinusoidal terms from sensor data. `curve_fit` remains the sole key shipped skill.
